revisions.change_explanation: Initial comparison-fixture place: the death place the annals name, kept with unknown geometry because no source in the set identifies its site.

content.summary: 雲陽, the place where the annals record 韓非 dying after Qin detained him. The record keeps the name and asserts no position: no source in this set locates the Qin 雲陽, and the modern town of the same name is not used as an identification.

geometry.notes: The annals name 雲陽 as the place of the death; the cited entries state no site for the Qin 雲陽, and the record asserts no coordinate rather than equating it with the modern town of the same name.

content.editorial_notes: The place stays listable and unmarked. A source that identifies the Qin 雲陽 is what would place it; none in this set does.

claims.statement: The annals record that Qin detained 韓非 and that he died at 雲陽, in the same 十四年 (233 BCE) entry.

locator.value: 卷六 秦始皇本紀 十四年（非死雲陽）

citations.quoted_text: 韓非使秦，秦用李斯謀，留非，非死雲陽。

claims.statement: The cited entries name 雲陽 as the death place and state no site for it, so the record carries unknown geometry with no coordinates.
